name: Arambourgia
sum: Arambourgia is a monotypic alligatorine crocodylian from the Eocene of Europe, found in karstic deposits.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Not given in the sources consulted; named Alligator gaudryi by de Stefano (1905).
material: The sources consulted do not list the material.
biology: Its unusual anatomy and karstic setting led to a proposed habit, but the sources consulted here give no direct evidence of diet.
author: de Stefano 1905

sources.text: Brochu, Christopher A. 2004. Alligatorine phylogeny and the status of Allognathosuchus Mook, 1921. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 24(4): 857–873. doi:10.1671/0272-4634(2004)024[0857:APATSO]2.0.CO;2
